_note: s154: the DOS presentation the remaster's path with AMIGA SCREENS off follows, whatever graphics pack is drawn (so not in a graphics pack: amiga.json's map_message is the Amiga's requesters). Static [C] (reverse-engineering/dos/logic-specs/message-and-text.md 'Text boxes, key waits and timed lines', endgame.md 4 'Timing') + DOSBox-X s154. map_boxes: the string ids whose lines DOS prints in its centred band (OV2 0xda83 / 0xdad1 / 0xdb41 = COM 0x2e5f / 0x2ead / 0x2f1d), each waiting for a key (COM 0x37a0); keys on the overworld, dungeon_keys in the dungeon; splits: an id DOS shows on two rows (0x722f, 0xdad1). Core's own window marks (MESS text, damage reports, location pages) wait too; they need no list. defeat: OV1 0x24c's 0xe81c(500) = COM 0x3bf8(500): each line of the party defeat holds 500 hundredths of a second; a key ends the line's wait early (key_ends_line).
_pages_note: s156 static [C] + DOSBox-X: the places of the map's boxes on DOS's 40 x 25 grid (8 x 8 cells). band_top_row: COM 0x2e5f / 0x2ead / 0x2f1d fill rows 9..(10 + n) full width, the n rows centred as stored ((40 - length) / 2, a sign's padding counted) on rows 10.., a ruled row above and below (live s154 / s156: white 2-px rules at y 73-74 and 93-94 for one row; s45's Red Pony sign: two rows, rules at 73-74 and 101-102, its padded 39-character rows from columns 2 and 9; three rows inferred [~]). text_top_row: 0x2a95 fills rows 4..(5 + n), the 40-character records from column 0 on rows 5.. (live s156, DNG9's gate text: rules at y 33-34 and 69-70 for three records). reports: OV2 0xb9d1(column, row, last column, last row) and the print_at calls after it: the trap 0x3097 / 0x30a9 (6..33, title (13, 8), rows from column 7 (0x3125...), row 10 per the spec), ops 1-4 0x25d1 (6..34, (16, 8), (7, 10)), swimming 0x6956 (1..38, (14, 8), (2, 10)), the pool 0x658d (8..29, (12, 8), (9, 10)), the wilderness inn 0x6749 (5..32, (13, 8), (6, 10)); every one rows 7..16; the frame a 2-px white line inset in the edge cells (live s43 swim / s45 inn shots).
